## About

Suresh Jayachandhiran is a UI/UX Designer and Front-End Developer specializing in modern, responsive, and user-centric digital experiences. His expertise includes website design, WordPress development, Shopify development, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, and Illustrator.
